A '''scanning crew''' is a group that investigates the interior of vessels. Several were stationed on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], including [[Scanning crew BT-445/Legends|Scanning crew BT-445]].
